title: Continuation Expression Evaluation Order
purpose: Define the ordered evaluation pipeline for continuation expressions before introducing recovery or executable reduction algorithms.
core_claim: Continuation evaluation is ordered, and failure classification occurs before composition is admitted.

canonical_claims.statement: Failure classification occurs before composition is admitted.
Reduction is permitted only after well-formedness, typing, transition, endpoint, admissibility, and residue checks pass.
Evaluation order does not modify RT_core.

formal_objects.name: Continuation Expression Evaluation Order
formal_objects.definition: Ordered evaluation pipeline for continuation expressions from parsing through reduction eligibility.

validation_requirements: Evaluation order is registered as an ordered pipeline.
Reduction remains gated by WF(C), typing, transition, endpoint, admissibility, and residue checks.

next_recommended_patch.title: Minimal Continuation Reduction Algorithm
next_recommended_patch.purpose: Introduce the smallest governed reduction procedure after evaluation order and failure boundaries are fixed.
